scope: Limited implementation-oriented mechanics for this prototype; not a rulebook reproduction.

rules.summary: Percentile regular check: succeed at or below the skill value divided by 1, rounded down. MCP owns the roll.
Percentile hard check: succeed at or below the skill value divided by 2, rounded down. MCP owns the roll.
Percentile extreme check: succeed at or below the skill value divided by 5, rounded down. MCP owns the roll.
After a failed eligible skill check, one explicitly chosen, justified push is a new check; failure may have a more serious consequence. Never reroll automatically.
Use the current Luck value for a regular percentile check through the existing skill-check primitive. This subset does not support Luck spending or pushing Luck checks.
Compare a percentile roll to current SAN. Supply both loss expressions from the scenario; MCP evaluates the applicable loss and clamps SAN. Missing expressions require explicit resolution.
Use bounded positive NdM expressions. MCP generates the dice and total; this subset has no arithmetic modifiers.

request_when: The outcome is meaningfully uncertain and failure has a meaningful consequence.
The scenario explicitly requests a check.
avoid_when: Ordinary actions have no meaningful uncertainty.
Scenario or state already guarantees the outcome.
Repeating attempts until success has no scenario or rule justification.
